_doc: THE source for which backtested systems may be enabled for the pilot. Replaces the 'top N' / 'top20' selection (owner decision 2026-09-26, ADR 0008). A system is enabled only if it passes EVERY criterion of its horizon on its in-sample window AND on its untouched out-of-sample window (INT-5, oos6m). There is no ranking cut-off: every system that passes is eligible, and a horizon with no passing system trades nothing. Returns are account-level, net of fees/slippage, sized with live-parity 1% risk (risk-config.json max_risk_pct).
source: owner answers 2026-09-26: scalping = 'TB tháng >= 5%'; day/swing = 'Bảo toàn vốn'

scalping._applies_to: minute- and second-scale systems (15m today; seconds-scale Heatmap/Footprint systems later)

_notes: monthly_return_pct_target is the owner's aspiration (10%); it is reported, never used to reject.
A month with no trades counts as a 0% month, never as missing.
Sample-size honesty (CLAUDE.md §39): each result is reported with its trade count; the gate does not hide a thin sample.
